text:
sofia: FYI CI red on release branch. regen diff non-empty causing publish hook to abort.
lee: saw it. typegen output reordered changelog sections, semver-check sees a bump mismatch.
sofia: example error: `publish-check failed: semver verification mismatch (expected patch, found minor)`.
ci-bot: CI job 4997 failed: typegen-regendiff. Logs: /ci/4997/typegen.log
tara: did anyone hand-edit CHANGELOG.md?
lee: nope. I suspect the openapi -> typegen pass pulled maps in a non-deterministic order after we bumped the plugin deps.
sofia: okay can we make codegen sort release entries deterministically (by date then id)?
tara: also the changelog-checker should ignore pure-order diffs. right now it treats any diff as a semver-change.
ops-bot: note: branch protection blocks merges until regen diff empty.
lee: quick plan: 1) add stable sort in codegen templates, 2) normalize frontmatter (strip generated timestamps) in changelog comparator, 3) add unit test + pre-commit hook.
sofia: i'll cut a tiny PR for the sort change and run local regen.
ci-bot: build 4998 queued: run typegen-regendiff.
tara: also watch for YAML whitespace normalization, that caused a false diff last month. canonicalizer should collapse insignificant whitespace and remove meta keys like `generated_timestamp` and `tool_version`.
lee: got a local patch. `make regen` produces only re-ordering diffs now. attaching outputs to PR.
sofia: PR #7922 created with codegen stable-sort change. included before/after regen snapshot.
ci-bot: build 4998 failed: changelog-check still flagged mismatch (frontmatter timestamp different).
lee: fixed comparator to drop known meta keys before diff, and normalize date formats. Pushing patch.
tara: good. after merge, we should add a publish-script tolerance: if normalized content equal, skip semver check and allow patch. but we must log that behavior.
sofia: agreed. also adding a short note to onboarding checklist: run `make regen` and `git add -A` before creating release PRs.
ci-bot: build 4999 started.
ci-bot: build 4999 succeeded: typegen-regendiff OK.
ops-bot: merging allowed: branch protection satisfied.
lee: merging PRs now and will publish a patch to internal codegen package.
tara: leaving a short blurb for release notes: "Fix: deterministic ordering from OpenAPI -> typegen to prevent spurious semver failures during release."
sofia: thanks! let's follow up with a tiny postmortem and add the pre-commit hook to the mono-repo.
